page.layout: One printed title page, all lines centred. Top: author's name and title in several lines. Middle: an engraved emblem with doves, a sun and a crown. Bottom: printer's imprint and date. No page number, running head or signature.

main_text.l: Omni curâ ac diligentiâ exipsius Au-

page.notes: The engraving between the title lines and the imprint shows a crowned emblem with two doves, rays of light above, and foliage around it; it is not text. Handwriting ("Bibl:", "Coll: Rom: Soc Iesu" and similar) is left out. Two library stamps (an oval "Biblioteca Nazionale Roma" stamp at left and an oval stamp at right) are left out, as is the digitiser's mark at bottom right. The date is printed "cIↄ-Iↄc XL." and is given as MDCXL. The line "exipsius" is printed without a space; it is copied as printed.
